title: bomboaddons
description: BomboAddons is a comprehensive utility mod for Hypixel SkyBlock on Fabric. It provides a wide range of essential Quality of Life (QoL) overlays, solvers, and advanced mechanics to help players optimize their efficiency in the Garden, Dungeons, and beyond.
body:
## ⚙️ 1. General Settings

Contains broad quality-of-life additions, auto-solvers, tooltips, and client performance enhancements.

- __Sign Calculator:__ shows the results on calcs on signs for easier buying/selling.

- __SBE Commands:__ Enables custom commands and behaviors mimicking SkyBlock Extras (SBE), such as networth and skills checks.
  
- __Copy Chat:__ Adds a the option to copy chat messages with a click (supports color codes).

- __Left Click Etherwarp:__ Allows left-clicking to activate your Aspect of the Void (AOTV) Etherwarp.

- __Sphinx Solver:__ Assists in solving the Sphinx puzzle in SkyBlock.

  - *Hollow Wand Fix:* Fixes the block interactions and allows clicking through players when holding a Hollow Wand.

- __Auto Accept Carnival:__ Automatically accepts Carnival prompts.

- __Lowest BIN Tooltip:__ Shows the lowest Buy-It-Now (BIN) Auction House and bazaar prices to item tooltips.

- __NPC Sell Price Tooltip:__ Displays NPC sell prices to item tooltips.

- __Auto Trevor Quest:__ Automatically accepts Trevor the Trapper hunting quests.

- __Hoppity Egg Finder:__

  - *Egg Finder Chat Alerts:* Alerts you in chat when an egg is located.
  - *Egg Finder Waypoints* Shows a waypoint with the egg location.
  - *Egg Finder Beacon:* Renders a beacon at the egg's location.

- __Ignore Caps Lock:__ Makes keybinds function properly even when Caps Lock is toggled on.

- __Server List Button & Reconnect Button:__ Direct shortcuts added to in-game menus for easier navigation and server rejoin.

- __Quick Join Commands:__ Shortcuts like `/f1` (floor 1), `/m1` (master 1), etc., for joining SkyBlock instances quickly.

- __Auto Reconnect:__ Automatically attempts to rejoin the server upon a connection loss.

- __Party Commands:__

  - *Toggle:* Enables/disables processing of commands issued by party members.
  - *Prefixes:* Configures prefixes (such as `!`, `.`, `?`).
  - *Built-in Commands:* Includes `!timer` (starts countdowns), `!warp` (warps the party), and `!psa` (allows the all invite setting).

- __Hypixel Shortcut Button:__ Fast access button directly added onto main GUI screens.

- __Smart Disconnect:__ Adds a confirmation when trying to disconnect from a server.

- __Borderless Fullscreen:__ Forces the game into borderless windowed mode.


---

## 📊 2. HUDs & Overlays

Customizable visual indicators that render vital information directly on the HUD.

- __Dice Tracker HUD:__ Tracker to check how much you win gambling.

- __Feast Bakery HUD:__ Shows the best item in terms of coins/kernel on the Feast event.

- __RNG Profit HUD:__ Displays the most profit book from the enchanting table for metter.

- __Custom Timers HUD:__ An overlay showing all custom countdown timers active.

- __Item List Sidebar:__ An in-game sidebar listing active items.

---

## 🏡 3. Garden Settings

A comprehensive suite of indicators, macro checkers, and helpers for farming in the Garden.

- __Garden Movement Keybinds:__ Custom key mappings for Forward, Backward, Left, Right, Break, and Use.

- __Lock Mouse on Movement:__ Locks cursor inputs to stabilize angles during movement.

- __Direction Helper Warning:__ Tells you when you start farming again on the wrong side (usefull when killing pests).
  

- __Pest Highlights:__

  - *Pest Waypoints:* Highlights active pest locations with custom highlights.
  - *Tracers with Custom Colors:* Draws line tracers pointing directly to active pests.

---

## ⌨️ 4. Hotkeys

Fast-access keybind definitions to trigger actions instantly:

- __Trade / Recipe / Usage:__ Opens quick-lookup recipes and trade menus.
- __Show Info / Count Items:__ Displays metadata and counts matching items.
- __Copy NBT:__ Copies the NBT tag data of any item you hover over.
- __GFS Max / GFS Stack:__ Quick replenishment from your Sack.
- __Chat Peek:__ Peeks at chat history without opening the full chat interface.
- __Menu Page Navigation:__ Next Page, Previous Page, Go Back, and Smart Back buttons.
- __Run Clipboard Cmd:__ Executes whatever command is currently on your clipboard.

---

## 👤 5. Profiles & Binds

- __Profile Management:__ Set up separate profiles (e.g., `default`, customized setups) to quickly toggle entire groups of keybinds.

- __Multi-Conditional Keybinds:__ Map keys to commands with strict conditions:

  - *Required Island:* Bind only triggers if you are in a specific zone (e.g., Garden, Crimson Isle).
  - *Required Armor:* Bind only triggers if you are wearing specific armor sets.

---

## 🎯 6. Clickers

- __ GUI Keypress Clicker:__ Custom triggers that click slots or interact with custom item names in specified container GUIs when a mapped key is pressed (similar to wardrobe keybinds).

---

## 🔦 7. Custom Mob Highlights/tracer

- __Custom Mob Highlights:__ Add mob names to draw entities/mobs bounding boxes around those entities to highlight them.

---

## 👗 8. Wardrobe Keybinds

- __Disable Unequip:__ Prevents accidental removal of your armor sets.
- __Slot Keybinds:__ Map direct keybinds for Wardrobe Slots 1 through 9.

---

## 🐙 9. Kuudra Settings

Modules tailored for Boss fights in the Kuudra fight.

- __Blindness Timer & Disable Blindness:__ Shows a timer when you are gonna get eaten by kuudra (useful for insta stun).


- __Auto GFS Toxic & Twilight:__ Gets arrows when kuudra is gonna get stunned.

- __Pearl Waypoints:__ Predicts and solves throw angles and timers:

  - *Pearl Throw Timer:* Shows countdowns for throws.
  - *Pearl Positions:* Configurable filters for Flat, Sky, and Double pearl locations.

---

## 🐾 10. Pets

- __Pet Hotkeys:__ Quickly swap pets with custom keybinds.
- __Disable Unequip:__ Prevents unequipping active pets with keybind.

---

## 🗺️ 11. Custom Waypoints

- Manage custom coordinates (X, Y, Z) bound to specific SkyBlock zones. Includes:

  - *Show Through Walls:* View indicators through solid blocks.
  - *Show Beacon:* Renders a vertical light beam.
  - *Customizable Colors.*
  - *Only on specific Islands and profiles*

---

## 🔀 12. Command Aliases

- Map custom commands to short aliases (e.g., instead of /warp dh > /dh).

---

## 💬 13. Chat Triggers

- Define specific chat matching phrases. When detected in chat, they can:

  - *Run a customized Command.*
  - *Render a custom title overlay on screen.*

---

## 💀 14. Dungeons

- __Dungeon Secrets Tracker:__ Shows teammates secrets at the end of the dungeon run.
- __Pad Timers:__ Shows a custimizable timer for storm crush (useful for py).

---

## 📍 15. Coord Binds

- Triggers commands when you walk within a certain radius of specified coordinates. Highly customized with *island filters*, *min/max random delays*, and *auto-waypoints*. (useful to tell teammates when you are at ee for example)

---

## ⛏️ 16. Mining (Corpse highlight)

- __Corpse highlight:__ Highlighting boxes and line tracers pointing directly to mining corpses.
- __Hide Opened Corpses:__ Filters out corpses that have already been looted.
- __Custom Colors:__ Specify distinct outline and fill colors for each corpse tier: *Lapis*, *Tungsten*, *Umber*, and *Vanguard*.

---

## 🧱 17. Block & Particle Highlights

- __Block Highlights:__ Customizable highlights for blocks (e.g., blocks matching specific names/IDs).
- __Particle Highlights:__ Draw custom colors on specified visual particle groups.

---

## 🎯 18. Custom Crosshair

- Fully design custom reticles inside a pixel grid, or choose from standard presets with adjustable *chroma*, *static colors*, and *outline options*.
